name: trustlink-pay
description: TrustLink Pay - Identity-first blockchain payments on Solana. Send stablecoins to phone numbers, resolved through TSN privacy-preserving settlement network. Built with WhatsApp auth, Cranker liquidity, and on-chain TINS identity.

author.name: Agbaka Matthew Daniel aka Big Dreams Web3

scripts.dev:mempool:backend: cd tsn-mempool-backend && set MEMPOOL_STORE=file&& set PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1&& python -u server.py
scripts.dev:tsn:stack: npx concurrently -n backend,frontend,mempool-ui -c cyan,green,yellow "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:mempool:frontend"
scripts.dev:tsn:stack:with-mempool: npx concurrently --prefix "[{name}]" --timestamp-format "HH:mm:ss" --kill-others-on-fail -n backend,frontend,mempool-api,mempool-ui -c cyan,green,magenta,yellow "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:mempool:backend" "npm run dev:mempool:frontend"
scripts.dev:tsn:stack:with-cranker: npx concurrently -n backend,frontend,mempool-api,mempool-ui,cranker -c cyan,green,magenta,yellow,blue "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:mempool:backend" "npm run dev:mempool:frontend" "npm run tsn:cranker:start"
scripts.dev:all:hint: echo "Run in separate terminals:" && echo "1) npm run dev:backend" && echo "2) npm run dev:frontend" && echo "3) npm run dev:mempool:backend" && echo "4) npm run dev:mempool:frontend"
scripts.tsn:sdk:relink: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.tsn:sdk:reinstall:all: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix tsn-cranker-sdk install && npm --prefix tsn-cranker-op-daemon install && npm --prefix tsn-mempool-frontend install
scripts.tsn:sdk:refresh: npm --prefix tsn-sdk install && npm run tsn:sdk:build && npm --prefix tsn-cranker-sdk install && npm run tsn:cranker-sdk:build && npm run tsn:sdk:reinstall:all && npm run tsn:sdk:clean-cache
scripts.tsn:rebuild:all: npm run tsn:program:build && npm run tsn:sdk:refresh
scripts.tsn:redeploy:all: npm run tsn:program:build && npm run tsn:program:deploy && npm run tsn:sdk:refresh
scripts.tsn:check:types: npm --prefix tsn-sdk exec -- tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && cd tsn-cranker-op-daemon && .\node_modules\.bin\tsc.cmd --noEmit --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --types node --allowImportingTsExtensions --skipLibCheck scripts\cranker.ts
scripts.tins:deploy: cd tins-registrar/program && solana program deploy target/deploy/tins_program.so --url devnet
scripts.git:pull:all: git pull origin main && git submodule update --init --recursive
scripts.git:commit:push:all: git add -A && git commit -m "Update submodules" && git push --recurse-submodules=on-demand origin main --force
scripts.git:quick:push: git diff-index --quiet HEAD || (git add . && git commit -m "Something just got updated!" --allow-empty && git push origin main)
scripts.git:force:push: git add . && git commit -m "Something just got updated!" --no-verify --allow-empty && git push origin main --force
